_: It.20: the capstone — a FULLY CUSTOM Aimed projectile damage spell (custom MGEF + custom SPEL), given to a custom NPC who casts it AT AN ENEMY IN COMBAT. Combines It.12 (custom MGEF authoring, in-game-confirmed for self-cast/potions only) with It.17 (NPC combat-casting via spells[]+combatStyle+AIData). It.12 explicitly left 'Aimed damage spells need a projectile + casting/hit art' as FUTURE — this closes it. The MGEF reuses the vanilla firebolt PROJECTILE (0x10FBEA) + casting art (0x01B211) so the bolt is VISIBLE and delivers the hit; all functional fields (archetype/flags/skill/cost/cast/target) are authored to match vanilla FireDamageFFAimed75 (verified via mgefdiag). The damage value itself is ours.

magicEffects.name: Flame Lance
magicEffects.description: A lance of fire that sears the target.
magicEffects._: Mirrors vanilla FireDamageFFAimed75 (0x10F7F1) functional fields: ValueModifier/Health, Destruction, ResistFire, FireAndForget/Aimed, Hostile+Detrimental+NoArea, baseCost 3.3 (It.12 lesson: keep baseCost low for sane autocalc; NO Recover flag on an instant effect or the damage is undone). projectile+castingArt reuse vanilla firebolt assets so it's visible and actually hits.

spells.name: Flame Lance
spells._: Wraps the custom MGEF at magnitude 30 (firebolt-tier). spellType=Spell, FireAndForget/Aimed mirrors the effect. equipType=EitherHand (Skyrim.esm:0x013F44) is REQUIRED for an NPC to equip the spell into a hand and cast it in combat (It.20 new field). baseCost 0 = let the engine autocalc from the effect.

combatStyles._: csVampireMagic profile (via cstydiag) — magic-preferring so the AI picks the spell over melee.

npcs.name: ModForge Flame Mage
npcs._spells: The NPC's known spell is OUR custom spell — not a vanilla one. This is the It.20 proof point.

placements._: Tamriel wilderness (It.9 confirmed-working coords). Tester walks up and `placeatme 0x0009AE36` (Wolf) to give her a target — she should cast OUR Flame Lance at the wolf: a fire bolt travels and damages it.
